messages:
jenn_onboard: Quick kickoff note for Archipelago onboarding — want to align owners, top success metrics, immediate blockers, and a tentative 6-week rollout plan. Root stakeholders: Alex (CTO), Lina (Product), Omar (SRE).

sam_enable: I can run the enablement. Thinking two sessions: 90m dev deep-dive (SDK patterns, sample prompts, error handling) + 45m ops walkthrough (healthchecks, alerts, rollbacks). Prework: devs need API key + sample dataset.

mike_se: I'll own integration & CI. Proposal: start with redwood-algo-13b-int8 for perf/cost tradeoff. Need request schema and a test bag of representative queries. Also request network details for the VPC peering.

raj_success: I'll set up a lightweight 30/60 dashboard and weekly health checks. Contract renewal at month 11 — commercial risk unless we show clear usage and 2 measurable wins by month 4. Marking as "watch" for now.

evan_csm: Proposed sync rhythm: 30m weekly ops for first 8 weeks, ad-hoc during cutover. I'll coordinate executive touchpoints if adoption stalls.

jenn_onboard: Immediate asks for Archipelago: 1) Omar/Alex — VPC allowlist + target RPS, 2) Lina — canonical prompt set + KPI expectations, 3) Alex — SSO contact for test account.

sam_enable: Suggested dates: Tue 4/9 10am PT (dev 90m) and Thu 4/11 2pm PT (ops 45m). I'll draft agendas and short prework checklist (incl. sample queries, Postman collection).

mike_se: Minimal CI env snippet for their repo:
```
# .env.ci
REDWOOD_KEY=redacted_xxx
REDWOOD_MODEL=redwood-algo-13b-int8
REDWOOD_URL=https://api.redwood.prod/v1/chat
CI_TEST_PROMPT_FILE=tests/prompts/archipelago_sanity.json
```
I'll push a starter PR with integration tests by Mon.

raj_success: Risks tracker: SSO delay, VPC CIDR changes, data sampling delays. I'll email a short checklist and add a dashboard template to /templates/onboard/archipelago.

evan_csm: Feedback capture plan: weekly 15m with Lina for first month; log asks in GH with label "archipelago-onboard"; summarize wins/asks in a one-pager after week 4. Sam — can you create the GH board and a Notion note for enablement assets?

sam_enable: Yep — creating Notion page + GH board now; will post links before Tue. Adding a tiny 5-question quiz for dev session to validate readiness.

jenn_onboard: Logistics: propose kickoff meeting Fri 4/5 9am PT — short 20m with all stakeholders + our leads (Mike, Sam, Raj, Evan). @calendar-bot please schedule Zoom and include the one-pager draft.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Archipelago Handoff & Roadmap — Fri Apr 5, 9:00am PT • 20m. Attendees: jenn_onboard, mike_se, sam_enable, raj_success, evan_csm; Guests: Alex (Archipelago), Lina (Archipelago), Omar (Archipelago). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/example

mike_se: I'll bring a short slide: expected p95 under load, and a simple rollback path. Will have perf numbers for redwood-algo-13b-int8 and a fallback config.

raj_success: Action items I own: dashboard skeleton by Tue EOD, risk checklist email now, attach SLO template to Notion.

evan_csm: Commercial metrics I'd monitor: weekly active devs, calls/day, median latency, and one customer-facing outcome metric Lina cares about. I'll draft a metrics sheet and share by Mon.

jenn_onboard: Summary action list from thread: 1) calendar-bot: kickoff scheduled (done); 2) sam_enable: Notion + GH board + agendas before Tue; 3) mike_se: starter PR + perf slides by Mon; 4) raj_success: dashboard + checklist by Tue EOD; 5) evan_csm: metrics sheet by Mon; 6) Archipelago: VPC CIDR, SSO contact, sample prompts. I'll DM Alex to chase items. Thanks all :thumbsup:
